summary.title: Vue.js Application Tutorial – Creating a Simple Budgeting App with Vue
summary.one_liner: A step-by-step walkthrough of building a complete budgeting application in Vue.js, showing how the pieces, code structure and development process fit together.
takeaways: See how a complete Vue.js application is organized from planning through final steps.
Learn how to structure data and project files for a small Vue app (accounts, budgets, transactions).
Follow along with per-commit notes and the public Budgeterium GitHub repository.
Learn to add LocalStorage persistence and dynamic components to a Vue app.
summary.summary: The tutorial builds a budgeting application in Vue.js, presented as 14 numbered steps covering planning, data architecture, project setup, creating and editing accounts, LocalStorage, budgeting, dynamic components, transactions, styling and navigation, and user testing. The author logs each commit to the public Budgeterium GitHub repository and links notes to each commit so readers can inspect or clone the changes. It is aimed at readers who already know front-end basics and Vue (and can use vue-cli), and it focuses on concepts and structure rather than line-by-line explanation. A work-in-progress demo of the app is linked from the page.
